name: tp-remote
description: TP Remote — internal development workspace. All rights reserved.

scripts.bindings:generate: cargo run -q --locked -p tp-test-harness --bin tp-bindings -- generate apps/desktop/src/bindings
scripts.bindings:check: cargo run -q --locked -p tp-test-harness --bin tp-bindings -- check apps/desktop/src/bindings
scripts.contract:check: npm run bindings:check && cargo test -q --locked -p tp-contracts -p tp-protocol -p tp-test-harness -p tp-desktop && npm run test -w @tp-remote/desktop -- src/contract
